# Order Entry

> **Short description**
>
> New Orders can be entered via a user interface within the Order module. This epic contains the stories for the entry process via this user interface.

---

## How to Start

Order Entry is started from the [Order Portal](https://your-confluence.example.com/spaces/DOCS/pages/123456/Order+Portal) by clicking:

- the **New** button when a new Order has to be created; or
- the **Modify** button when an existing Order has to be changed.

The screen is opened in a new tab.

---

## Layout

- When started from **New**, all fields are empty except for the defaults.
- In **modify mode**, all fields are pre-filled with the values from the database.

---

## Screen Elements

### Tab button

Clicking the **X** in the tab button closes the Order Entry UI.

### Quick-Access Buttons

**Refresh**

Immediately refreshes the UI:
- New entry: all fields are cleared except for defaults.
- Modify mode: all fields revert to the original values from the database.

> **Message:** If unsaved changes exist, a confirmation dialog is shown. Click **Yes** to refresh (changes lost) or **No** to return to the current state.

---

**Save**

Saves the new or modified Order immediately. Disabled when a pending grid change has not been confirmed or cancelled.

- Mandatory fields are marked with a red asterisk and red borders.
- If no approval is required: a success message is shown after saving, and the entry form resets for a new entry.
- If DeliveryDate is not a business day: _"DeliveryDate must be a business day"_.
- If save fails due to validation: a message box informs the user. A red error-detection button appears next to **Save & Close** with details.
- If the record was updated by another user in the meantime: save fails with a concurrent-update message.
- After successful save: INV service **Create and Return Invoice Account** is called to create a billing account (AccountType = 'R'). If approval is required (Status = 'PendingReview'), the INV call happens after approval.

---

**Save & Close**

Same behaviour as **Save**, except that on successful save the UI closes and the user is redirected to the Portal (which is refreshed).

> **Message:** If Save is clicked when no changes have been made, a warning message appears.

---

## Entry Fields

### Order Details

| Attribute | Format | Mandatory | Editable on Modify | Default (new entry) | Validation on Entry | Validation on Save | Example | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Id** | Not visible | YES | No | | | | | Internal identifier |
| **Status** | Read Only | Yes | No | | | | New | PendingReview \| Placed \| Rejected \| Cancelled \| Fulfilled |
| **CustomerNumber** | | Yes | No | Customer Number & Name (from customer search) | | | 500012345 | Configure selection of active CustomerClass(es) |
| **AccountNumber** | Read Only — INV service | Yes | No | `<blank>` for new | | | | Generated by INV 'Create and Return' service (AccountType 'R'). If approval required, generated after approval. |
| **AccountName** | Text, max 40 chars | Yes | No | `"Order:" "Placed" DD-MM-YYYY "Due" DD-MM-YYYY` | | | ORD-14032026-21032026 | Auto-generated from order and delivery dates |
| **CurrencyISOCode** | Drop-down (single select) | Yes | No | Store currency | | | EUR | |
| **OrderTotal** | 99,999,999.99 | Yes | No | | | Min-max check (see table below) | 250.00 | Configure per tier and currency — see limits table below |
| **OrderDate** | DD-MM-YYYY (Read Only) | Yes | No | = BusinessDate | | | 14-03-2026 | [Common Calendar](https://your-confluence.example.com/spaces/DOCS/pages/123457/Calendar) |
| **Use Delivery-Speed table** | True / False | Yes | No | Configured per tier | | | True | If not applicable, field is hidden |
| **DeliverySpeed** | Drop-down (Interval + Unit) | Yes (if Delivery-Speed table = TRUE) | No | Based on Customer.RegionId and CurrencyISOCode | | | 7 days | Only active speeds from the Delivery-Speed table are shown |
| **DeliveryDate** | DD-MM-YYYY | Yes | No | OrderDate + Interval (if table applied) — Read Only | | DeliveryDate must be a business day | 21-03-2026 | If table applied: computed from OrderDate + Interval. If table not applied: manual entry. Must be a business day (next business day selected if not). |
| **BillingAccount** | Drop-down (Code, Name) | Yes | No | Invoice account where CurrencyISOCode matches order currency | | | 500078692 | Config per tier: AccountType(s) shown in dropdown — typically 'R' (Receivable) and 'P' (Prepaid). |
| **DiscountRate** | Percentage 99.99 (Read Only) | Yes | No | From Delivery-Speed table or manual input | | | 5.00% | If table applied: auto-selected based on DeliverySpeed. If not: manual entry. |
| **ShippingFee** | Amount 99.99 | No | No | 0.00 | | | 4.90 | If ShippingFee > 0.00 and UseApproval = True: status becomes 'PendingReview' after save. |
| **SplitShipment** | Drop-down Yes / No | Yes | No | NO if OrderTotal < 100.00 (disabled). NO if OrderTotal >= 100.00. | | | No | Ship items in separate parcels or in one parcel |
| **ExpressDelivery** | Drop-down Yes / No | Yes | **Yes** | NO | | | No | Whether express delivery is requested before DeliveryDate |
| **GiftWrap** | Drop-down Yes / No | Yes | **Yes** | NO | | | No | Whether the order is gift wrapped |
| **Last Update Time** | Not visible | | | | | | | Datetime of last successful save |
| **Last Updated By** | Not visible | | | | | | | Username of last successful save |

### OrderTotal — Tier Limits

| Tier | Currency | Min | Max |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TIER_A | EUR | >= 20.00 | <= 5,000.00 |
| TIER_A | non-EUR | >= 30.00 (in store currency) | — |
| TIER_B | EUR | >= 50.00 | <= 1,500.00 |
| TIER_B | non-EUR | >= 75.00 (in store currency) | — |

> **Validation on Save:** _"OrderTotal: The amount in euros must be between `<min>` and `<max>`"_
> For non-EUR: _"OrderTotal non euro: The equivalent value of the amount in euros must be between `<min>` and `<max>`"_

### Status Values

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| **PendingReview** | Waiting for approval by a second user |
| **Placed** | OrderDate <= CurrentDate |
| **Rejected** | Order rejected during approval |
| **Cancelled** | Order cancelled before DeliveryDate |
| **Fulfilled** | DeliveryDate <= CurrentDate |
